title: Civil Draftsperson - Microstation and ProjectWise
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in engineering drafting / engineering design?
Do you have experience working on civil infrastructure projects?
How many years' experience do you have as a MicroStation Draftsperson?
rationale: Civil Draftsperson in Abbotsford Melbourne matches location and drafting target.
Roads, drainage and earthworks portfolio overlaps Advanced Diploma coursework.
Office-based Melbourne west-adjacent is a strong location fit.
caution: Essential strong experience in Bentley MicroStation and ProjectWise; Marc's drafting tools are AutoCAD and Civil 3D from study, not MicroStation.
mandatory_unmet: Strong experience using Bentley MicroStation and/or OpenRoads Designer
Strong experience using and managing ProjectWise
